device.based_on: Original Soviet design by Vladimir Kuzmin; produced from 1982, sold only in the USSR. Technical conditions 3.849.014 TU.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic (1-voice) or duophonic (2-voice): Generator I follows the highest key held, Generator II the lowest; one filter and amplifier shared
architecture.summary: Two wide-range generators (triangle, sawtooth, square and two pulse widths; 32' to 2'), Generator II detunable by about two tones and able to frequency-modulate Generator I; white noise and an external input; a mixer with four levels. The filter (Kuzmin's design on K140UD12 programmable op-amps) is low-pass or band-pass with cutoff, resonance ('characteristic harshness' at high settings), envelope and modulator depth, and pedal control. Filter and amplifier each have an envelope with attack, decay, pedestal (sustain level), after-sound (release) and a single or repeating ('накат') mode. One modulator: triangle, square, noise (random pulses) or stepped (sample and hold), routed to both generators, the filter and the amplifier. Glissando on Generator I; key-memory switch.

modules.name: Keyboard
modules.description: 49-key (F-E) keyboard with magnetically controlled reed contacts; duophonic scanner gives top and bottom key; mono or duo; key memory (ВКЛ.) holds the last key.

modules.name: Generator I (ГЕНЕРАТОР I)
modules.description: Wide-range oscillator: range (ДИАПАЗОН, octave steps), shape (ФОРМА), modulator depth (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ), FM from Generator II (ГЕНЕРАТОР II); glissando.

modules.name: Generator II (ГЕНЕРАТОР II)
modules.description: Wide-range oscillator: range, shape, modulator depth and detune (РАССТРОЙКА, ±25 %, about ±2 tones) against Generator I.

modules.name: Noise generator
modules.description: White noise for non-musical sounds (wind, surf, steam engine).

modules.name: External input
modules.description: External source (guitar, electric piano, organ) into the mixer.

modules.name: Mixer (МИКШЕР)
modules.description: Generator I, Generator II, noise and external levels, independent.

modules.name: Modulator (МОДУЛЯТОР)
modules.description: Triangle, square, noise (chaotic pulses) or stepped (sample and hold) at ЧАСТОТА rate, with LED; feeds both generators, the filter and the amplifier.

modules.name: Filter (ФИЛЬТР)
modules.description: Kuzmin's state-variable filter on K140UD12 programmable op-amps: low-pass 12 dB/oct or band-pass 6 dB/oct (ПФ/ФНЧ); cutoff 100 Hz-10 kHz; resonance gives the characteristic harshness and self-oscillation.

modules.name: Filter envelope
modules.description: Attack, decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ), pedestal (ПЬЕДЕСТАЛ, sustain level), after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧАНИЕ, release); single or repeating (накат) mode.

modules.name: Amplifier envelope
modules.description: Attack, decay, pedestal, after-sound; single or repeating mode.

modules.name: Amplifier (УСИЛИТЕЛЬ)
modules.description: Final stage: loudness under the amplifier envelope, plus modulator tremolo.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Output level and output switch; low (0.025 V) and high (0.25 V) level outputs into 10 kohm; headphones.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Generators, noise and external input mixed into one filter and one amplifier; both voices share them in duophonic mode.

behaviours.name: Duophonic keyboard
behaviours.rule: 2-ГОЛ.: Generator I follows the highest key held and Generator II the lowest (glissando on Generator I only). 1-ГОЛ.: both follow one key. ВКЛ. in the back position holds the last key's pitch while the envelopes keep working.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: Each key: rise at the attack rate, fall at the decay rate to the pedestal, and on release fall at the after-sound rate. Pedestal fully right disables the decay; pedestal at 0 returns to the start, and in repeat (накат) mode the cycle repeats until the key is released.

behaviours.name: Filter
behaviours.rule: Low-pass or band-pass; cutoff 0 silences everything; resonance gives the famous harshness; the envelope moves the cutoff up from the ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА setting; the pedal raises the cutoff.

behaviours.name: Modulator
behaviours.rule: Triangle, square, noise or stepped waveform to Generator I and II pitch, filter cutoff and loudness, each with its own depth.

behaviours.name: Tuning
behaviours.rule: Warm up 10 minutes; remove the cover to reach eight trimmers; tune Generator I with СМЕЩЕНИЕ and СТРОЙ on the upper and lower A, then РЕГИСТРЫ across ranges; then Generator II against Generator I.

midi.note: No MIDI or CV as built; retrofits for CV/gate and MIDI are common.

specifications.filter: low-pass 12 dB / band-pass 6 dB, 100 Hz-10 kHz

source_inconsistencies: Polynominal lists 48 keys and a 'Lowpass / High pass' filter; the manual and other sources give 49 keys (F-E) and low-pass / band-pass.
Vintage Synth Explorer lists the modulator as triangle, saw, square and random; the manual describes triangle, square, noise (chaotic pulses) and stepped (sample and hold).
Kuzmin's article says only that one generator follows the top key and one the bottom; Russian Wikipedia assigns the top key to Generator I.
The manual's operating-temperature line OCRs as '+10...+35'; an English translation gives '-10 / +35'.
The manual describes generator shapes as triangle, sawtooth and 'rectangular with various duty cycles'; online sources name five shapes (triangle, saw, square, pulse 1, pulse 2).

modelling_gaps.detail: Russian OCR of a poor scan; legend items 16 and 18 are partly illegible (18 inferred as a second output level).
This models the instrument's controls and signal flow; a working clone needs the service schematic, which was not available.
Six of the eight tuning trimmers are named in Fig. 3; the other two are not legible.
